cases.sentence: Я наведу на всю твою ___ лягушек.
cases.explain: The preposition на with direction takes the accusative; feminine nouns in -а end in -у in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Они вылезут из ___ и прискачут в твой дворец.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) always governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Аарон занес руку с посохом над водами Египта, и вылезли лягушки и покрыли всю землю.
reading.question: What happened when Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters?
options: Frogs came up and covered the land
reading.correct: Frogs came up and covered the land
reading.explain: The text says frogs came up and covered the whole land.

reading.ru: Но чародеи с помощью колдовства сделали то же самое.
reading.question: What did the magicians do?
options: The same thing by their enchantments
reading.correct: The same thing by their enchantments
reading.explain: The text says the magicians did the same thing by their sorcery.

reading.ru: Лягушки вымерли в домах, во дворах и на полях.
reading.question: Where did the frogs die?
reading.explain: The text says the frogs died in the houses, courtyards and fields.

reading.ru: Чародеи попытались с помощью колдовства навести комаров, но не смогли.
reading.question: Could the magicians reproduce the plague of gnats?
reading.explain: The text says the magicians tried by their sorcery but could not.

reading.question: How many flies remained after Moses prayed?
reading.explain: The text says not one fly remained.

reading.ru: Но и на этот раз сердце фараона осталось упрямым, и он не отпустил народ.
reading.question: What was Pharaoh's response after the flies were removed?
options: His heart stayed stubborn and he did not release the people
reading.correct: His heart stayed stubborn and he did not release the people
reading.explain: The text says this time too Pharaoh's heart remained stubborn and he did not let the people go.
